Ravi: Quick thread  planning the newsletter + webinar invite for next Thurs. Need final subject, RSVP form fields, routing rules, and suppression list.
June: Core cohorts: trial-30d, newsletter-active (30d opens), docs-downloaders. Docs-downloaders = high-intent.
Marta: RSVP should capture name, email, company, role, size, and "interested in demo". Hidden UTMs: utm_campaign=orbit_bench, source=email, cohort={cohort}.
Ollie: Suggest subject variants: A) 'Live: inference benchmark + ops walk' B) 'What lowered our inference cost 4x'  test emoji vs none.
Ravi: Routing pseudo-rule: if (role =~ /(Head|Director|CTO|PM|ML)/ || company_size >= 500) -> sdr-enterprise else if (cohort=="trial") -> sdr-trial else -> sdr-nurture.
June: Suppress anyone who attended/RSVP'd in last 60d, unsubscribed, or bounced. Dedupe across cohorts (highest intent wins).
Marta: Confirmation flow: RSVP -> calendar add + conditional "book demo" for enterprise leads. Also capture "reason for attending" (benchmark/cost/ops).
calendar-bot: Reminder: webhook deploy for RSVP -> CRM staging scheduled Wed 18:00 PT.
Ollie: I'll drop copy & 3 subject lines into #copy-review in 2hrs. We'll run 10% subject A/B on newsletter-active cohort.
Ravi: Owners: Marta (form + UTMs), June (segments & suppression), Ollie (copy + subject tests), calendar-bot (deploy). 15m pre-send check Wed 3PM PT.
Marta: Noted, will QA lead mapping in staging and simulate routing.
